page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.4xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The x86_64 architecture utilizes a single thread per core configuration, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyper-threading overhead.

The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage options. There are no integrated GPUs on this instance type.

Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio make this instance type suitable for compute-intensive workloads such as batch processing, high-performance web serving, scientific modeling, and distributed analytics where consistent CPU performance is required.
